evidence.statement: Read the listed records. The confirmation set (273 rows) was smaller than the 333 the chartered power needs, so the charter run's scope is exploratory_unconfirmed and its claims are tiered accordingly. The extract has no timestamp or key, so the row number and boarding date are assumptions, and the row number correlates with the target because the extract is ordered. Played by the author.

reviewer.name: reviewer-role (the author, with the reviewer key)

thresholds.reason: fewer rows than this make the interval too wide
training gain must carry over to validation
lower end of the cross-validated ROC AUC

acceptance.reason: ranking must beat a coin by a wide margin
set after seeing the held-out evaluation, so it is a post-hoc ceiling, not a prospective one

expectation.basis: 95% normal interval of the cost per case of the rule on the 217 held-out test rows, widened by 0.005 and rounded; fixed before the replay was scored through the loop

kpis.kpi: Expected cost of mis-prioritised briefings per passenger (missing a survivor costs 5, briefing a non-survivor costs 1)

stakeholder.name: stakeholder-role (the author, with the stakeholder key)
